sections.title: Booking and order management menu
sections.content:
![](/uploads/7b398c1fd8ca5109d0ed3554.png)

- **Bookings**: this menu contains every booking and order.

- **Booking documents**: this menu contains every document of the bookings and orders.

sections.title: Creating a booking or order
sections.content:
## Note A booking sent by a customer normally becomes one booking or order in the system. In some cases, though, one customer booking has to be split into several bookings or orders in the system. The dispatcher can split it as needed. ## Creating a new booking or order ### Step 1 Go to a booking or order menu → click **New**. ![](/uploads/e0165940063b39c9a16852ec.png) ### Step 2 Enter the main information of the order. ![](/uploads/acd40a818b5977c4950e858f.png) | **Field** | **Description** | |---|---| | Booking code | Enter the booking number or the reference order number. | | Order code | Leave this empty; the system generates it. | | Customer | Select the customer. Type a name or a phone number to search. | | Tracking code | Leave this empty; the system generates it. | | Person in charge | Select the person in charge of the booking on the customer side. | | Internal person in charge | The person in charge of this booking inside your company. The system defaults to whoever created the booking; you can change it. | | Order type | Select an order type. The order type decides what other information the system shows — order documents, the default task list, and so on. The order types are:
**- Export a full container:**
  - For a full container export booking.
  - Default tasks: pick up empty container, drop off empty container, pick up laden container, deliver laden container.
**- Import a full container:**
  - For a full container import booking.
  - Default tasks: pick up laden container, deliver laden container, pick up empty container, return empty container.
**- Move an empty container:**
  - For moving a container between ports or depots.
  - Default tasks: pick up empty container, drop off empty container.
**- Move a laden container:**
  - For moving a laden container between domestic ports or depots.
  - Default tasks: pick up laden container, deliver laden container.
**- Bulk cargo:**
  - For carrying cargo on a flatbed or skeletal trailer.
  - Default tasks: pick up cargo, deliver cargo. | | Booking note | Enter a note for the booking or order — for example the list of places where an empty container can be picked up. | ### Step 3 Enter the order size, which is the number of containers the customer has asked you to carry for this booking. - The system loads this table when you select the **Order type**. Enter the number of containers of each type in the **Quantity** column. ![](/uploads/4a6b93d1abe7eb07c88b1d19.png) ### Step 4 Attach the documents of the order. ![](/uploads/2dd16c49f0bbd7f842cd9b8f.png) | **Field** | **Description** | |---|---| | Document type | When you select the **Order type**, the system loads this list from what has been configured. | | Share with the driver | Lets you share the document attached to the order so the driver has everything they need while working. | | Description | Add details for each document. | | Attachment | Click **ATTACH DOCUMENT** to upload files from your computer. | | Hard copy status | Two values:
- No hard copy
- Hard copy received
If the customer has already given you the hard copy of that document, set it to "Hard copy received" to record that. | If you need documents beyond the default list, click ***"Add a line"*** to add another document type to the order. ### Step 5 Enter the transport plan. ![](/uploads/40ccc5d5ff3ed886c493c84c.png) | **Field** | **Description** | |---|---| | Empty container delivery deadline | Enter the time the customer wants the empty container delivered to their warehouse. Applies to full container export orders. | | SI Cutoff | Enter the SI Cutoff time. Applies to full container export orders. | | Port Cutoff | Enter the SI/CY Cutoff time. Applies to full container export orders. | | Laden container delivery date | Enter the time the customer wants the laden container delivered to their warehouse. Applies to full container import orders. | | DEM date | Enter the DEM time. Applies to full container import orders. | | DET date | Enter the DET time. Applies to full container import orders. | | Order task list table | Depending on the order type you selected, the system loads the default task list already configured. This is the route of tasks the driver has to follow.
You also need to fill in the location, planned date and deadline columns. | ### Step 6 Click **SAVE**, or press **CTRL + S**, to save the order. ![](/uploads/83bfee84827f9b72950ed62b.png) The system records who created the order and when on the [Other information] tab: ![](/uploads/25b7ba8e9094adcfc4dc2cde.png)

sections.title: Confirming a booking or order
sections.content:
**There are two ways to confirm a booking or order**

- **Option 1:** confirm one specific booking or order.

- **Option 2:** confirm many bookings or orders at once.

## Option 1

Confirming one specific booking or order

- **Step 1:** on the details screen of an order → click **CONFIRM**. When you confirm, the system checks whether all the required documents are attached and whether the task route table is filled in.
- If the system warns you, complete the missing information and confirm again.

![](/uploads/b6d23b87dd1d8089a349e450.png)

- **Step 2:** a successfully confirmed order shows the message below. Click **CLOSE**, or press **ESC**, to dismiss it. The order then moves to the **CONFIRMED** state.

![](/uploads/255b3914079f91873e7737bb.png)

![](/uploads/e80ecac090ea68ded0f6108d.png)

## Option 2

Confirming many bookings or orders at once

- **Step 1:** open the booking or order list → tick the bookings and orders you want to confirm.

![](/uploads/0e9f059ea09dcf7777264bc2.png)

- **Step 2:** click **CONFIRM**. When you confirm, the system checks whether all the required documents are attached and whether the task route table is filled in for each order. If the system warns you, complete the missing information and confirm again.

![](/uploads/2ccdb0bd37646ff461df72d0.png)

- **Step 3:** a successfully confirmed order shows the message below. Click **CLOSE**, or press **ESC**, to dismiss it. The order then moves to the **CONFIRMED** state.

![](/uploads/a9f7045537af88bdf068f73e.png)

sections.title: Canceling a booking or order
sections.content:
## Note

You can only cancel an order while it is **NEW** or **CONFIRMED**.

## Canceling an order

### Step 1

Open the order you want to cancel → click **CANCEL**.

![](/uploads/1d2adc0e943a001a6016753a.png)

### Step 2

The system asks "Are you sure you want to cancel the order?" → if you are, click **OK**.

![](/uploads/072b27fed846e962e7c4c92c.png)

### Step 3

The order has been canceled and moves to the **CANCELED** state, as below.

![](/uploads/64cc03b547d65a295d71e5fe.png)

sections.title: Deleting a booking or order
sections.content:
## Note

You can only delete an order while it is **NEW** or **CANCELED**.

## Deleting an order

### Step 1

Open the order you want to delete, or open the order list and tick the orders you want to delete → click the action icon (the cog) → click the delete action, as below.

![](/uploads/37335a3d55c72bc1e2a9cc7c.png)

![](/uploads/e2d83ec14dcb688acccf425f.png)

### Step 2

The system asks you to confirm that you want to delete the data. If you are sure, click OK.

![](/uploads/5cbcf84fcb76dc2ac884b041.png)

sections.title: The states of a booking or order
sections.content:
**A booking or order has the following states:**

1. **New:** the order has just been created.

2. **Confirmed:** the order has been confirmed successfully.

3. **Waybill:** containers and waybills have been created for the order and they are not complete yet.

4. **Completed:** every container and waybill of the order is complete.

5. **Canceled:** the order has been canceled, or every container and waybill of the order has been canceled.

sections.title: Viewing the planned date of an order
sections.content:
By default the system sorts orders by planned date, newest first.

**The timeline columns:** the system collects the important dates of an order in these columns.

![](/uploads/37a02ebe541c10d1a3368834.png)

If you need specific date columns for sorting or for a closer look, click the icon at the end of the header and turn on the fields you want:

![](/uploads/8924cabb096b501188d187d6.png)

sections.title: The overdue status of a booking or order
sections.content:
## The overdue statuses of an order

1. **Overdue:** past the deadline.

2. **Due soon:** within 6 hours of the deadline.

3. **Normal:** more than 6 hours before the deadline.

## How the system works out whether an order is overdue

(*) For orders that already have containers and waybills:

1. **An "Overdue" order:**

   a. When any waybill is incomplete and that waybill is "Overdue".

   b. A waybill is "Overdue" when one of its tasks is "Overdue" and that task is not complete.

2. **A "Due soon" order:**

   a. When any waybill is incomplete and that waybill is "Due soon".

   b. A waybill is "Due soon" when one of its tasks is "Due soon" and that task is not complete.

3. **A "Normal" order:**

   a. When every waybill is "Normal".

   b. A waybill is "Normal" when every one of its tasks is "Normal".

(*) For orders with no waybill yet, the system uses the deadline on the order's task table:

1. **An "Overdue" order:**

   a. When any task is "Overdue".

2. **A "Due soon" order:**

   a. When any task is "Due soon".

3. **A "Normal" order:**

   a. When every task is "Normal".

## Viewing the overdue status

### In the booking and order list

The system shows a light column so you can tell the overdue status of an order at a glance.

- **Overdue:** red light

- **Due soon:** yellow light

- **Normal:** green light

![](/uploads/fc7ceda662dc1a308fda4090.png)

### On the details screen of a booking or order

When an order is "Due soon" or "Overdue", the system shows a matching ribbon as below.

![](/uploads/9cfa661e0eb61df9b23a116a.png)

The system also provides the "Overdue" and "Due soon" filters and a grouping by "Overdue status" so you can filter the data easily:

![](/uploads/7bf9c3bd930bcab955ccee8d.png)

![](/uploads/c635bc2ede811c8d48b9368c.png)

sections.title: Viewing container status from a booking or order
sections.content:
There are two ways to see the status of the containers in an order:

- From the order list

- On the details screen of an order

### From the order list

You can check the waybill status of an order at a glance, as below:

![](/uploads/9b8912a6e063812a84b43486.png)

- The **Waybill status** column: the system shows the number of containers and waybills per status.

  - **Created:** the total number of containers created for the order.

  - **To create:** from the number of containers you entered in the order size table and the number already created, the system works out how many are left to create.

  - **Confirmed:** the number of containers in the "Confirmed" state.

  - **Assigned:** the number of containers in the "Assigned" state.

  - **In progress:** the number of containers in the "In progress" state.

  - **Completed:** the number of containers in the "Completed" state.

  - **Not completed:** the number of containers in the "Not completed" state.

  - **Canceled:** the number of containers in the "Canceled" state.


### On the order details screen

You can also see the waybill status and the waybill list of an order on the [Container/Waybill] tab (1), or by clicking the **Waybill** link button (2), as below.

![](/uploads/b7dd902632639fcf7a74594e.png)
